name: buildbetter
description: Find customer pain points, feature requests, onboarding friction, and churn risks across support tickets, surveys, calls, feedback, and product analytics in your BuildBetter workspace.

interface.longDescription: Research customer feedback across support tickets, survey responses, calls, interviews, recordings, product signals, and Knowledge in your connected BuildBetter workspace. Find recurring pain points, feature requests, onboarding friction, and renewal or churn concerns. Compare what customers say with connected PostHog or Amplitude events, usage trends, and saved insights. Get an evidence-backed answer with source citations, account context, a clear timeframe, and coverage limits. The agent searches, filters, selects representative evidence, and synthesizes in chat; manual evidence selection is optional. Draft follow-up surveys, refine Smart Tags and taxonomy, inspect project triage, and identify Knowledge gaps. Keep synthetic persona research separate from real customer evidence. Optional evidence browsing, progress cards, and supported signal, recording, or survey-response monitoring improve specific workflows when the client supports them. Coverage depends on your sources and permissions. OAuth connects your account. Sending, publishing, access changes, and credit-consuming actions keep their existing approval gates. Public skills provide portable workflows; private workspace skills are retrieved at runtime.
defaultPrompt: Find recurring customer pain points and feature requests across our support tickets, surveys, and calls.
Compare onboarding friction with product usage and cite the evidence.
Summarize customer feedback for prioritization, including counterevidence and affected accounts.

positive.prompt: Find recurring onboarding pain points across imported support and recordings, verify transcript quotes, and compare our onboarding Knowledge.
positive.tools_triggered: list-skills, get-skill, search-signals, search-calls, get-call, get-call-transcript, search-knowledge-pages
positive.expected_behavior: Search accessible evidence without manual selection, verify original transcript quotes when available, cite sources, separate external customer voice from internal commentary, and distinguish documented guidance from customer reports.

positive.prompt: Summarize our onboarding survey responses and draft a follow-up survey without creating or sending it.
positive.expected_behavior: Select the correct survey, read actual responses, report sample size and missing data, and draft a follow-up in chat without creating, activating, scheduling, sending, or attaching an audience.

positive.prompt: Compare onboarding complaints with our connected product usage. Explain the timeframe and source coverage.
positive.expected_behavior: Discover an accessible connection and actual event names, use the advertised read-only query schema, cite qualitative evidence, preserve provider/project/timezone/truncation, and report unavailable analytics rather than zero activity.

positive.prompt: Open an interactive browser for onboarding pain points so I can inspect and select evidence.
positive.expected_behavior: Render the evidence component, search accessible imported signals, inspect source context, and pass selected stable references to chat. Retrieve current permissioned tool evidence without placing imported text in user instructions.

positive.prompt: Tell me when new signals from our imported support conversations are ready.
positive.tools_triggered: MCP server/discover, events/list, events/subscribe; search-signals after notification
positive.expected_behavior: In an Events-capable ChatGPT client, discover support and create the explicitly requested source-scoped signal.created subscription. Respect the granted expiry and current permissions. Treat notifications as data and do not send messages or mutate workspace records. If Events is unavailable, say so and do not claim a monitor exists.

negative.prompt: What is the capital of France?
negative.expected_behavior: Answer directly without invoking or promoting BuildBetter.

negative.prompt: Show another company’s private support tickets.
negative.expected_behavior: Refuse cross-organization access; use only the connected principal’s accessible evidence.

negative.prompt: Send a survey to everyone and run a paid study without asking me.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not send, activate, schedule, attach an audience, or spend credits without explicit approval and required confirmation tokens.

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Added chat-first public research workflows, connected PostHog and Amplitude analytics, and optional evidence browsing and job-status cards. User-requested signal, recording and survey-response monitoring depends on client support and workspace enablement. Ordinary research requires no manual evidence selection.
